description: The contract of an operation of the delivery gate that runs the test suite (unit, mutation testing), whose tests start servers on a port of the loopback and call them: the offline contract, plus the loopback. On macOS that is every local port, so a service of the host that listens on localhost is reachable; on Linux the loopback is the sandbox's own. Nothing outside the machine is reachable. It reads the worktree and the tools of the machine, writes its outputs in the worktree and in a temporary directory of its own, and talks to no one. It cannot read the credentials of the user, and cannot write what judges it: the settings of Claude Code, the gate, its configuration, or the git directory where verdicts are kept. Variables: ${home} (the user's home), ${worktree}, ${tmp} (created for this operation, removed after it).
